subject: As a Security Guard, I want to create inward and other-vehicle passes with camera capture, OCR I confirm, PO checks and an offline queue, then let out only vehicles cleared to leave, so that every truck is logged and released correctly.

As a Weighbridge Operator or Quality Inspector, I want stable-only weight capture with manual and re-capture history, and a quality queue with per-line results, so that weights and inspections are correct and traceable.
Remove the legacy PATCH /api/entries/{id}/weight route so weight can only be recorded through the weighment rules

As a Store In-charge, I want GRNs only after quality, editable drafts, segregation of duty, ERP posting with retry and clear failure messages, so that material is received correctly and reaches the ERP once.
Add an erp_error_code next to erp_last_error on GRN responses (grn_posting.py, grn_views.py)
Show a translated ERP failure message per erp_error_code with the raw text as detail in GrnPage.jsx and GrnEditor.jsx

As an Admin, I want role-based sign-in and full user management, including password reset, self-service password change, a failed-login limit and an audit of user changes, so that access is safe and reviewable.
Add POST /api/auth/change-password, a failed-login throttle on POST /api/auth/login, and user-admin audit rows in routers/users.py with a user_audit_log migration for review
Add reset-password and edit-name actions on UsersPage.jsx and a change-password form on AccountPage.jsx
As a Site Supervisor, I want a live dashboard and a filterable Entry Log that loads in pages, so that I can follow the site and find any vehicle fast as history grows.
Add limit/offset and a total count to GET /api/entries, checking indexes on vehicle_entries
Add Load more to the Log cards and table (EntriesPage.jsx, EntryTable.jsx, useEntries.js)
As any user, I want mobile cards and tabs, breadcrumbs, an offline notice and every screen and error message in English, Hindi or Marathi, so that I can work on site in the language I read best.
Map the photo-upload and Internal server error messages in apiErrors.js with keys in strings/common.js
Build the GRN weighed-by notice and waiting-time line from single templates in GrnEditor.jsx and GrnPage.jsx
Add an app-wide offline banner and disable write actions outside Gate-in
